design_brief: Software/hardware startup prototyping without replacing every desk with a server rack.
gameplay_scope: Art and future layout proposal only; no new hiring, role behavior, tool authority, transaction or interaction is implemented.

current_availability.direction_art_review: N/E/S/W passive engineer-build-kit-v2 art passes the September 6 agent-native review on the accepted workstations-v2 desk. Both required layers, exact desk registration, gaze-relative tool identity, and actual-room evidence pass. Approval is passive-library only: no production/runtime binding, default-layout placement, engineer employee, engineer pose, service, behavior, interaction, backend, device execution, or hire.
current_availability.previous_native_review: No finished art or runtime family is claimed for this proposal; unrelated concept/source art may exist.

native_geometry.anchor_rule: One unchanged canvas coordinate represents local floor pivot [0,0] in every direction and every layer. Transparent padding is not sprite scaling.
native_geometry.host_rule: Primary-host export shares the accepted desk canvas and floor anchor; zero new floor collision. A second host requires an explicitly reviewed socket adaptation, not runtime downscaling.
